title: 01 — Spojrzenie
description:
19-sekundowa pętla Dołącz: widz zagląda do świata AI MFTV. Czesław po lewej, Halinka po prawej, przy biurku pełnym papierów w lokalu zastępczym. W tle realna elewacja KTS w Łazach przy Spółdzielczej 2. Bez mówienia i świadomego kontaktu z kamerą. Ruch uspokojony, zoom pozostawiony playerowi.

Czesław przenosi uwagę z dokumentów na Halinkę. Krótka niema wymiana spojrzeń.

Start: zaakceptowany oryginał A v002. Aktualna reżyseria i czas mikrogestów: prompts.animation; rzeczywisty wynik: take-1.

prompts.image: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit image 1, the existing canonical opening film frame, producing one photorealistic 16:9 1920x1080 still. Image 1 is the edit target and locks ALL interior pixels and both characters: exact faces, hairstyles, clothing, glasses, hands, tea cups, saucers, binder, paper stacks, phone, camera angle, doorjamb, lighting and framing. Image 2 is an authentic photograph of the KTS building at Spoldzielcza 2, Lazy, Poland, and supplies ONLY the exterior seen THROUGH THE LEFT WINDOW. Replace the yellow excavator, blue industrial barriers and construction-site view outside that window with a geographically believable view toward the cream-colored two-storey SIDE FACADE of this exact real building. Preserve its distinctive evenly spaced dark rectangular windows, subtle vertical pilasters, grey plinth and leafy tree by the corner. Show only a partial section of this facade and the tree through the existing Venetian blinds, at a plausible distance across a small courtyard. Ground outside should be a quiet finished ordinary courtyard, no construction equipment, excavation or rubble. Match perspective and natural morning light to the existing window, slightly softer than the subjects but recognizable as image 2. Do NOT paste the entire reference photo into the window; render the correct partial street-level view from this interior. Existing blinds, window frame, reflections and foreground occlusions remain exactly as in image 1. Change nothing else inside: even the pinned construction PHOTOGRAPHS on the wall remain unchanged, since these are paperwork not the view outdoors. Czeslaw still looks down at the binder, Halinka at him; neither looks at camera. No new people, new furniture, extra glasses, hand changes, text overlays or watermarks. This is a surgical exterior-background correction, not a redesign.
prompts.endFrameDescription: Bez zadanego End Frame. Ostatnia widoczna klatka gotowego take’a przekazana do Start następnego shota.
prompts.animation: @Element1 is Czeslaw already seated screen left; @Element2 is Halinka already seated screen right. @Image1 locks only Czeslaw’s existing glass, metal holder and saucer, not an additional object. 0–0.7s: Czeslaw glances from the open binder toward his paper stack. 0.7–1.8s: his eyes turn toward Halinka, followed by a small head turn. 1.8–2.5s: he slightly raises his eyebrows once, mouth closed. 2.5–3s: Halinka meets his gaze; they settle naturally. Camera: locked, no zoom. Secondary: quiet breathing, slight sleeve settling. Both glasses remain on their saucers, right hands keep their initial grips, left hands rest on the desk. Preserve identities, clothing, anatomy, glassware, room, exterior, lighting and all lettering. No speech, camera gaze, new people, duplicated objects, extra limbs, morphing, cuts, captions or watermarks.
